answer: New agents start on a probation mesa with capped rewards, and a randomly assigned lantern reviewer audits their work each epoch. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and pass a unique hardware-attested identity check prior to joining the harbor of verified peers. Sybil attackers must fund a fresh stake per fake identity plus hardware attestation, making mass forgery costlier than honest participation. In practice, once0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
